findings.evidence: Lines 207–213 bundle a particular tubular embedding into each framed knot, while lines 251–252 compare those full ranges; the PR description and roadmap’s `SmoothLink` presentation characterize links by their underlying embedded circles.
findings.fix: Require disjoint ranges of the underlying core embeddings, e.g. `Disjoint (range (component i).knot.knot) (range (component j).knot.knot)`, and derive any disjoint-neighborhood result separately after choosing/shrinking representatives.
findings.issue: `pairwise_disjoint` requires the entire chosen tubular-embedding ranges to be disjoint, although a link only requires pairwise-disjoint component images; individually valid framings with overlapping neighborhood representatives are therefore rejected.

summary: `SmoothLink` imposes disjointness at a stronger-than-natural level, making the type depend on arbitrary tubular-neighborhood representatives rather than the link cores.
